mantle" is called:

The theory that states "pieces of the Earth's crust are 
in constant, slow motion driven by movement in the 
mantle" is called:
questions.explanation_en:

the mantle. According to this theory, the earth surface is 
composed of several plates. Plates are the solid and rigid 
upper part above the asthenosphere segmented into sever-
al blocks. Those blocks are known as lithospheric plates.

tralian, Pacific, North American, South American and Ant-
arctic plates. Significantly plates constitute the entire sur-
face of the earth.
